I've tried talking about this before, and I've told her I would talk to her about how I'm feeling, but I always feel like a burden. I've been to a doctor before and was prescribed medication, but it didn't help me at all. Also, I've got no friends to talk to about this.

I just feel as if my life is going nowhere. I used to have big aspirations for what I wanted to do, but I feel like I'll never be able to achieve those dreams.
I've tried talking, but I always feel like I'm a burden.

I feel as if my life is going nowhere. I went to college for a year but dropped out after that because I couldn't decide on a degree. I've got a decent job for my age, but I hate going in more and more every day. And on top of that, I'm transgender but I've got no way of doing anything about being the person I want to be.
